messages:
Priya (Support): FYI escalated from AcmePayments — after yesterday's canary rollout they see our invoice-generator dropping the last line item when the prompt ends with a newline. Customer says this started immediately after the rollout. Request ID: rq_0a9c3f.
Alex (Eng): thanks. can you paste the exact prompt they sent + the API payload? any difference between working and broken cases?
Priya (Support): here's minimal repro from customer (they're using our hosted API). Working case (old):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-ark-7b\",
  \"input\": \"Generate invoice:\n- Item A $10\n- Item B $20\nTotal:\"
}
```
They say when they append a trailing newline after Total (i.e. end with `Total:\n`) the model output drops the `- Item B $20` line. Broken case (customer):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-ark-7b\",
  \"input\": \"Generate invoice:\n- Item A $10\n- Item B $20\nTotal:\n\"
}
```
Priya (Support): curl they ran:
```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}' -d @payload.json
```
Priya (Support): customer included model response snippets — working returned both items, broken returned only Item A (Item B missing). No HTTP errors, 200. Latency similar (~120ms).
Irene (ML): weird — this reads like a prompt-tokenization boundary issue. trailing newline may change chunking and trigger a different kernel or fallback quantization codepath. any model variant changes in rollout? which variant did canary push?
Priya (Support): rollout id `rollout-2026-03-16-ckpt-swap`. Canary set to 10% yesterday at 09:12 UTC. The catalog shows `redwood-ark-7b:q2` replaced `redwood-ark-7b:q1` on canary nodes.
Alex (Eng): good data. @Marco can you confirm the rollout timeline and whether canary nodes had a different tokenizer or tokenization lib version? also need full server logs for rq_0a9c3f (request routing, kernel selection).
Marco (SRE): checking logs now. I see the request landed on canary pool instance id `c-7f2`. Kernel selection trace: `kernel=v3-opt`, quantize fallback `q2` active. No errors. I can pull the full raw request/response.
Priya (Support): customer also sent prompt variants where they replace trailing newline with a space and it works. So it's definitely sensitive to that one char. They need a hotfix — they're blocked for an integration test.
Irene (ML): plausible explanation: our whitespace normalization changed subtly in q2 tokenization table; newline at end can drop a trailing token that our decoding constraints treat as prompt-completion boundary, causing a generation truncation. We should repro locally with exact tokenizer and q2 table.
Alex (Eng): plan: 1) reproduce locally with q2 artifact, exact prompt; 2) if repro, roll back canary to q1 and escalate patch. Marco — can you scale canary down to 0% or route this customer's org away from canary?  rq_0a9c3f should be included in logs export.
Marco (SRE): I can route `org:acmepayments` to stable pool as a targeted mitigation. Doing that now. Also initiating canary rollback request (manual) and pulling logs.
Deploy Bot: Deploy event: `rollout-2026-03-16-ckpt-swap` canary scaled to 10% at 2026-03-16T09:12:03Z by alex; rolling back initiated at 2026-03-17T14:23:10Z.
Priya (Support): told customer we have a mitigation (routing them to stable) and we're investigating root cause. They're happy for the targeted mitigation but want root cause and ETA.
Alex (Eng): Irene/Ml please confirm repro by EOD. If confirmed, prepare a small patch to tokenizer normalization or a decoding constraint workaround. Priya — keep customer updated, share ticket id.
Irene (ML): starting local repro now with `redwood-ark-7b:q2` artifact + same prompt. will post results. initial thought: likely a 1-line patch.
Priya (Support): thanks all — I posted the customer's contact and ticket in the CRM thread. I'll follow up with status updates. :thumbsup:
Marco (SRE): logs collected and uploaded to internal S3: s3://internal-logs/support/rq_0a9c3f.log
Alex (Eng): assign follow-up to #eng-ml and #eng-runtime after repro. tagging for visibility. :eyes:
